analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간을 벗어났으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물러 있으며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확신하기에는 미미한 수준. 52주 저가 대비 24.9% 위치에서 횡보하며 방향성 탐색 중.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory, and while MACD histogram shows improvement, it's not yet strong enough to confirm a trend reversal. The price is consolidating at 24.9% of its 52-week low, searching for direction.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 (101,640 KRW) / SMA200 (101,605 KRW): Below long-term trend, in a weak zone
